title: Quickselect
markdown:
Partition array around a pivot like Quick Sort, but recurse only into the side containing the target rank.

![Quickselect: Partition around pivot and prune unneeded side to find k-th order statistic](study/assets/asset-quickselect-Quickselect%20%E7%AE%97%E6%B3%95%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E5%9B%BE.png)

- Selection algorithm, not a sorting algorithm.
